subject: PINNED (operator decision): LODE-5 outcome→odds loop conflicts with calibration "measure, don't refit"
description: Blocked on a Frank decision — pinned in docs/design/owner-decisions/open-questions.md (2026-07-16). LODE-5 asks to close the outcome→odds loop, but calibration.py deliberately measures and never auto-refits (a single search's ~dozens of outcomes overfit). Options documented: (A) opt-in data-gated correction, default off, reliability-shrinkage recommended; (B) do nothing until real data crosses MIN_SAMPLE; (C) full refit (rejected). Scoring-side revealed-preference is LODE-7 (separate). Resume once Frank picks an option.
